question: Why did re-index appear to stop at regions and not produce polylines?
short_answer: The OCR/index phase finished through regions and legend rows. Sheet digitization did run and stored 2000 PDF vector polylines, but zero legend templates linked, so there are no utility-typed polylines (legend_line_type_id) and no label-seeded utility runs.

1_index_master_drawing.note: Regions are built inside index_master_drawing after text + legend clustering; this is not the last step.

2_viewport_seed.warning: Only a profile viewport was seeded (not plan). plan_bbox was unused for chain storage tiers.

4_utility_typed_polylines.reason: All 9 legend rows failed swatch extraction; no LegendLineTemplate objects; label_seeded_trace not populated.

root_cause_legend_templates.symptom: legend_template_diagnostics: all 9 rows skipped with swatch_style_found=false
root_cause_legend_templates.skip_reason: no vector segments inside swatch bbox
root_cause_legend_templates.meaning: extract_swatch_style requires PDF vector segments fully inside each swatch_bbox. On Master.pdf, zero segments fall inside those boxes at legend Y (~0.05–0.11, X ~0.72–0.78).

likely_causes: Legend swatch graphics are not stroked PDF vectors at those coordinates (raster/xobject or different layer).
Remaining native_pdf vs pdf_vector_line_extractor display-frame mismatch for legend column geometry (text bboxes align; vectors at legend stubs do not).
Swatch bboxes still misaligned (e.g. x0 0.724 vs real stubs ~0.7406) — even partial overlap would not satisfy fully-inside rule.

downstream: chain_typing_counts no_templates → every stored line has line_typing_status=no_templates, legend_line_type_id=null
enrich_ambiguous_chain_typings never runs meaningfully (no templates / no style_filter per code)
Scope/inspection utility polyline tracing has no typed SS/FW/E family to follow

have: 2000 untyped pdf_vector SheetLine polylines in index_stats_json.sheetEntityGraph.page.1
missing_for_utility_polyline: Merged TracedRun polylines (Step 4) — not invoked as separate persisted artifact today

if_digitization_disabled.note: If SHEET_DIGITIZATION_ENABLED=false, index would stop after regions/scale with no sheetEntityGraph lines at all. Your run has sheetEntityGraph → digitization was enabled.
